name: list_organizations
title: List organizations for the current user
description: Lists the organizations the user belongs to; an organization API key gets its own organization. search filters by name or id.

search.description: Part of an organization name or id, ignoring case.

annotations.title: List organizations for the current user

name: run_sql
title: Run SQL
description: Runs one SQL statement on a branch's database and returns its rows. After a prepare step, pass its temporary branch_id. NEVER run destructive SQL autonomously; always ask the user first.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

role_name.description: Postgres role to log in as. Omit for the database owner.

compute_id.description: Compute endpoint id (ep-...). Omit for the read-write compute.

max_rows.description: Rows to return per statement. Raise it only when a result has truncated: true.

name: run_sql_transaction
title: Run SQL Transaction
description: Runs several SQL statements in one transaction and returns each one's rows. After a prepare step, pass its temporary branch_id. NEVER run destructive SQL autonomously; always ask the user first.

sql_statements.description: The SQL statements to run, in order.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

role_name.description: Postgres role to log in as. Omit for the database owner.

compute_id.description: Compute endpoint id (ep-...). Omit for the read-write compute.

max_rows.description: Rows to return per statement. Raise it only when a result has truncated: true.

name: describe_table_schema
title: Describe Table Schema
description: Returns a table's columns, indexes, constraints, and sizes. For every table, use get_database_tables.

table_name.description: The table name, optionally schema-qualified (for example, crm.contacts)

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

name: get_database_tables
title: Get Database Tables
description: Lists a database's tables and views outside the system schemas. For one table's columns, use describe_table_schema.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

name: prepare_database_migration
title: Prepare Database Migration
description: Applies a schema change on a new temporary branch and returns a migration_id. Test it there with run_sql, ask the user, then always call complete_database_migration with the response's complete object so the branch is deleted.

migration_sql.description: The migration SQL. It is split on every semicolon, including one inside a string or function body.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

name: complete_database_migration
title: Complete Database Migration
description: Applies or discards a prepared migration and deletes the temporary branch. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. Pass the complete object from prepare_database_migration; apply_changes false discards.

database_name.description: The exact database_name from prepare_database_migration.

parent_branch_id.description: The branch the migration is applied to.

apply_changes.description: Apply the migration to the parent branch. false only deletes the temporary branch.

name: describe_branch
title: Describe Branch
description: Returns a branch summary, its database names, and a tree of one database's schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, and functions. Starts a suspended compute. Branch record only: get_branch; table names: get_database_tables; columns: describe_table_schema.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

name: get_connection_string
title: Get connection string
description: Returns a Postgres connection string with a role password; the branch needs a compute. Omitted inputs resolve like the SQL tools: default branch, neondb or the first database, and its owner. Call it after create_project or create_branch, which return none. `project_id` follows the connection scope. Requires write access: the connection string carries a privileged role password, so it is unavailable in read-only mode. A read-only caller who needs a DATABASE_URL must copy it from https://console.neon.tech manually.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

compute_id.description: Compute endpoint id (ep-...). Omit for the read-write compute.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

role_name.description: Postgres role to log in as. Omit for the database owner.

name: get_neon_auth_config
title: Get Neon Auth configuration
description: Returns a branch's Neon Auth integration and settings: trusted origins, localhost, email and password, OAuth and email providers, plugins, webhook, and logs export, with secrets redacted. Needs Neon Auth on the branch (provision_neon_auth).

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the project's default branch.

name: explain_sql_statement
title: Explain SQL Statement
description: Returns a statement's execution plan as JSON. analyze true executes it, side effects included, so never analyze potentially destructive SQL autonomously. For rows, use run_sql.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

analyze.description: Run EXPLAIN ANALYZE, which executes the statement and its side effects.

name: prepare_query_tuning
title: Prepare Query Tuning
description: Runs EXPLAIN ANALYZE for a slow query on a new temporary branch; returns the plan, table schemas, and a tuning_id. Try changes there with run_sql and explain_sql_statement, then always call complete_query_tuning with the complete object so the branch is deleted. Not prepare_database_migration.

sql.description: The slow SQL statement to analyze.

database_name.description: The database the statement runs in.

role_name.description: Postgres role to connect as. Omit for the database owner.

name: complete_query_tuning
title: Complete Query Tuning
description: Applies or discards query-tuning changes and deletes the temporary branch. NEVER run autonomously. Pass the complete object from prepare_query_tuning and suggested_sql_statements; apply_changes true applies, omitted discards. Call it even when the user rejects.

suggested_sql_statements.description: The DDL statements that improved the plan on the temporary branch, for example CREATE INDEX.

tuning_id.description: The tuning_id from prepare_query_tuning, not a branch id.

database_name.description: The database_name from prepare_query_tuning.

role_name.description: The role_name passed to prepare_query_tuning, if any. Omit for the database owner.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. The branch that receives the changes; omit it for the default branch.

name: list_slow_queries
title: List Slow Queries
description: Lists queries from pg_stat_statements, slowest mean execution time first. For sizes, indexes, locks, cache, bloat, or replication, use inspect_database.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

database_name.description: Database name. Omit for neondb, else the first database.

compute_id.description: Compute endpoint id (ep-...). Omit for the read-write compute.

limit.description: Maximum number of queries to return.

min_execution_time.description: Ignored; results are not filtered by time.

name: inspect_database
title: Inspect Database
description: Runs one read-only neon inspect db check; some are compute-wide. outliers ranks queries by total time and calls by count, both via pg_stat_statements; lfc-hit-rate and working-set need the neon extension. If one is missing, the error gives the CREATE EXTENSION; ask before running it. Other SQL: run_sql; one plan: explain_sql_statement; new indexes: prepare_query_tuning.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name. Omit it for the default branch.

database_name.description: Database to inspect, or to connect through for a compute-wide check. Omit for every database; one failure fails the run.

compute_id.description: Compute endpoint id (ep-...). Omit for the read-write compute.

limit.description: Rows to return. Raise it only when truncated is true.

name: search
title: Search Neon resources
description: Finds organizations, projects (including shared ones), branches, computes, and snapshots whose name or id contains query, with ids for fetch. To list projects, use list_projects; for docs, search_docs.

query.description: Part of a name or id, or a compute endpoint host from a connection string.

name: fetch
title: Fetch
description: Returns an organization, project, branch, compute, or snapshot by an id from search: markdown text, console URL, and records in metadata.

id.description: An id from search, such as project:<project_id>.

name: search_docs
title: Search Documentation
description: Searches neon.com docs, API reference, PostgreSQL tutorial, guides, FAQs, changelog, and blog for ranked pages with the slug get_doc reads.

query.description: What to search for, in words, e.g. "reset a branch" or "connection pooling".

categories.description: Only these categories; api is the API reference, postgresql the PostgreSQL tutorial.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return.

name: get_doc
title: Get Documentation Page
description: Returns one neon.com page as markdown, by the slug of a search_docs hit.

slug.description: The slug of a search_docs hit, e.g. 'docs/guides/prisma' or 'postgresql/tutorial/inner-join'.

name: send_feedback
title: Send Feedback
description: Sends anonymous feedback text to the Neon team, with no account, project, or connection details. Only call it when the user asks to give feedback.

feedback.description: The feedback to send to Neon. Do not include passwords, API keys, connection strings, or other secrets.

name: list_incidents
title: List Neon incidents
description: Lists open Neon incidents and maintenance from neonstatus.com and the affected components and regions. Needs no credentials. Call it when Neon requests fail unexpectedly or the user asks whether Neon is down.

name: list_projects
title: List projects
description: Lists the projects in an organization; search filters by name or id. To also find branches, computes, or snapshots, use search. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many. `org_id` is optional: organization API keys use their organization; personal API keys auto-select when unambiguous and otherwise return the IDs to choose from.

limit.description: Specify a value from 1 to 400 to limit number of projects in the response.

org_id.description: Organization id from list_organizations; required with a personal API key.

timeout.description: Specify an explicit timeout in milliseconds to limit response delay.

recoverable.description: Show only deleted projects within the recovery window.

name: count_projects
title: Retrieve projects count
description: Counts an organization's active projects without listing them; ones being created or deleted are not counted. `org_id` is optional: organization API keys use their organization; personal API keys auto-select when unambiguous and otherwise return the IDs to choose from.

org_id.description: Organization id from list_organizations; required with a personal API key.

name: describe_project
title: Retrieve project details
description: Gets a project's settings, owner, and usage. For branches, use list_branches.

name: create_project
title: Create project
description: Creates a project with a default branch and read-write compute and waits until it is ready. Returns no connection string; use get_connection_string. `org_id` is optional: organization API keys use their organization; personal API keys auto-select when unambiguous and otherwise return the IDs to choose from.

active_time_seconds.description: The total amount of wall-clock time allowed to be spent by the project's compute endpoints.

compute_time_seconds.description: The total amount of CPU seconds allowed to be spent by the project's compute endpoints.

written_data_bytes.description: Total amount of data written to all of a project's branches.

data_transfer_bytes.description: Total amount of data transferred from all of a project's branches using the proxy.

logical_size_bytes.description: Limit on the logical size of every project's branch.

ips.description: A list of IP addresses that are allowed to connect to the endpoint.

protected_branches_only.description: If true, the list will be applied only to protected branches.

allowed_ips.description: A list of IP addresses that are allowed to connect to the compute endpoint.

enable_logical_replication.description: Sets wal_level=logical for all compute endpoints in this project.

weekdays.description: A list of weekdays when the maintenance window is active.

start_time.description: Start time of the maintenance window, in the format of "HH:MM".

end_time.description: End time of the maintenance window, in the format of "HH:MM".

maintenance_window.description: A maintenance window is a time period during which Neon may perform maintenance on the project's infrastructure.

block_public_connections.description: When set, connections from the public internet are disallowed.

block_vpc_connections.description: When set, connections using VPC endpoints are disallowed.

hipaa.description: Enables HIPAA compliance mode for the project, including audit logging.

use_defaults.description: When true, the project's preload libraries include the platform default set in addition to any libraries listed in `enabled_libraries`.

enabled_libraries.description: Names of shared preload libraries to enable for the project.

preload_libraries.description: The shared libraries to preload into the project's compute instances.

allowed_origins.description: The browser origins allowed to connect, each `http` or `https` with a host and optional port and no path.

realtime.description: Enable Realtime for the default branch with these options.

database_name.description: The database name.

annotations.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata to attach to the branch.

branch.description: Configuration for the initial branch created with the project.

pg_settings.description: A raw representation of Postgres settings

pgbouncer_settings.description: Deprecated. Use the endpoint-level connection pooler configuration instead.

autoscaling_limit_min_cu.description: Minimum number of Compute Units for this endpoint.

autoscaling_limit_max_cu.description: Default maximum number of Compute Units for endpoints created under this account.

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Scale-to-zero idle timeout, in seconds, before the compute suspends.

default_endpoint_settings.description: A collection of settings for a Neon endpoint

store_passwords.description: Whether or not passwords are stored for roles in the Neon project.

history_retention_seconds.description: History window (point-in-time restore range) for all branches, in seconds.

org_id.description: ID of the organization that will own the project.

name: update_project
title: Update project
description: Updates a project's name, settings, default compute settings, or history retention.

active_time_seconds.description: The total amount of wall-clock time allowed to be spent by the project's compute endpoints.

compute_time_seconds.description: The total amount of CPU seconds allowed to be spent by the project's compute endpoints.

written_data_bytes.description: Total amount of data written to all of a project's branches.

data_transfer_bytes.description: Total amount of data transferred from all of a project's branches using the proxy.

logical_size_bytes.description: Limit on the logical size of every project's branch.

ips.description: A list of IP addresses that are allowed to connect to the endpoint.

protected_branches_only.description: If true, the list will be applied only to protected branches.

allowed_ips.description: A list of IP addresses that are allowed to connect to the compute endpoint.

enable_logical_replication.description: Sets wal_level=logical for all compute endpoints in this project.

weekdays.description: A list of weekdays when the maintenance window is active.

start_time.description: Start time of the maintenance window, in the format of "HH:MM".

end_time.description: End time of the maintenance window, in the format of "HH:MM".

maintenance_window.description: A maintenance window is a time period during which Neon may perform maintenance on the project's infrastructure.

block_public_connections.description: When set, connections from the public internet are disallowed.

block_vpc_connections.description: When set, connections using VPC endpoints are disallowed.

hipaa.description: Enables HIPAA compliance mode for the project, including audit logging.

use_defaults.description: When true, the project's preload libraries include the platform default set in addition to any libraries listed in `enabled_libraries`.

enabled_libraries.description: Names of shared preload libraries to enable for the project.

preload_libraries.description: The shared libraries to preload into the project's compute instances.

pg_settings.description: A raw representation of Postgres settings

pgbouncer_settings.description: Deprecated. Use the endpoint-level connection pooler configuration instead.

autoscaling_limit_min_cu.description: Minimum number of Compute Units for this endpoint.

autoscaling_limit_max_cu.description: Default maximum number of Compute Units for endpoints created under this account.

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Scale-to-zero idle timeout, in seconds, before the compute suspends.

default_endpoint_settings.description: A collection of settings for a Neon endpoint

history_retention_seconds.description: History window (point-in-time restore range) for all branches, in seconds.

name: delete_project
title: Delete project
description: Deletes a project with all its branches, computes, databases, and roles. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. recover_project undoes it within 7 days. For one branch, use delete_branch.

name: recover_project
title: Recover a deleted project
description: Recovers a project deleted in the last 7 days; list_projects with recoverable true finds them. Some integrations need setting up again.

name: list_project_permissions
title: List project access
description: Lists who has access to a project: each permission id, email, and grant date.

name: list_project_members
title: List org members and their project roles
description: Lists organization members and their roles on an org-owned project; 404 when the project is not org-owned or per-project roles are off. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

limit.description: The maximum number of members to return in the response

annotations.title: List org members and their project roles

name: list_regions
title: List regions
description: Lists the regions you can create projects in. An organization API key gets 404.

name: list_operations
title: List operations
description: Lists a project's operations; ones older than six months may be gone. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

limit.description: Specify a value from 1 to 1000 to limit number of operations in the response

name: get_operation
title: Retrieve operation details
description: Gets one operation and its status.

name: get_project_consumption
title: Retrieve project consumption metrics
description: Returns per-project consumption in an organization. metrics: every name get_branch_consumption takes, plus extra_branches_month and snapshot_storage_bytes_month. Launch, Scale, Agent, Business, or Enterprise plans; others get 403. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects per page.

project_ids.description: Up to 100 project ids. Omit for every project with history in the organization, including deleted ones.

granularity.description: hourly reaches back 168 hours, daily 60 days, monthly one year.

metrics.description: Metric names from the tool description. An unknown name returns no data rather than an error.

name: get_branch_consumption
title: Retrieve branch consumption metrics
description: Returns per-branch consumption for project_ids. metrics: compute_unit_seconds, root_branch_bytes_month, child_branch_bytes_month, instant_restore_bytes_month, public_network_transfer_bytes, private_network_transfer_bytes, functions_active_capacity_microseconds, functions_waiting_capacity_microseconds, functions_invocations, functions_egress_bytes. Usage-based Launch, Scale, Agent, or Enterprise plans only. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

limit.description: Maximum number of branches per page.

branch_ids.description: Optional branch IDs to filter the response (up to 100).

granularity.description: hourly reaches back 168 hours, daily 60 days, monthly one year.

metrics.description: Metric names from the tool description; any other returns HTTP 400. extra_branches_month and snapshot_storage_bytes_month are only on get_project_consumption.

name: list_branches
title: List branches
description: Lists a project's branches with id (br-...), name, parent, and default flag; search finds a branch's id by name. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

sort_order.description: Defines the sorting order of entities.

limit.description: The maximum number of records to be returned in the response

include_deleted.description: If true, return recoverable deleted branches too (soft-deleted within the recovery window).

name: get_branch
title: Retrieve branch details
description: Gets a branch record: name, parent, state, protection, size, and timestamps. For its databases and tables, use describe_branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: create_branch
title: Create branch
description: Creates a branch from its parent's current data, with a read-write compute unless no_compute, and waits until it is ready. Returns no connection string; use get_connection_string.

parent_id.description: Parent branch id (br-...). Omit for the project's default branch.

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Duration of inactivity in seconds after which the compute endpoint is automatically suspended.

compute.description: Autoscaling limits and suspend timeout for the read-write endpoint.

no_compute.description: Skip the read-write endpoint. Default false. Cannot be combined with compute.

name: update_branch
title: Update branch
description: Renames a branch, protects or unprotects it, or sets when it expires.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name.description: New display name for the branch.

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the branch is scheduled to expire and be automatically deleted.

name: delete_branch
title: Delete branch
description: Deletes a branch with all its data and disconnects its clients. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. The root, the default, and a branch with children cannot be deleted. For the whole project, use delete_project.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_default_branch
title: Get default branch
description: Gets the project's default branch by its default flag, not its name.

name: set_default_branch
title: Set branch as default
description: Makes a branch the project's default; the previous default loses the flag.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: reset_from_parent
title: Reset branch from parent
description: Resets a branch to its parent's current state, discarding the branch's own changes. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. preserve_under_name first saves the current state as a new branch. To restore a snapshot, use restore_snapshot.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

preserve_under_name.description: Name under which to save the current branch before the reset. Required when the branch has children; those children move to the new branch.

name: compare_database_schema
title: Compare database schema
description: Diffs one database's SQL schema on a branch against another branch, by default its parent. lsn, timestamp, base_lsn, and base_timestamp are only for point-in-time comparisons.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: Name of the database for which the schema is retrieved

base_branch_id.description: Branch id (br-...) to compare against, not its name. Omit for the parent branch.

lsn.description: The Log Sequence Number (LSN) for which the schema is retrieved

timestamp.description: The point in time for which the schema is retrieved

base_lsn.description: The Log Sequence Number (LSN) for the base branch schema

base_timestamp.description: The point in time for the base branch schema

name: finalize_branch_restore
title: Finalize branch restore from snapshot
description: Finalizes a branch restored with finalize false: moves the original branch's computes onto it, restarting them, and takes over its name.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: list_postgres_roles
title: List roles
description: Lists a branch's Postgres roles.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_postgres_role
title: Retrieve role details
description: Gets a Postgres role on a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: create_postgres_role
title: Create role
description: Creates a Postgres role on a branch and returns its password. The default access, admin, joins neon_superuser: every database, creating databases and roles, bypassing row-level security, and it cannot be narrowed later. For least privilege pass read_only or read_write with database_name and schemas, covering the tables the database owner owns, now and later.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

no_login.description: Whether to create a role that cannot login.

access.description: read_only grants SELECT; read_write adds INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and sequences, on top of what PUBLIC has. Default admin joins neon_superuser.

database_name.description: Database a read_only or read_write role is scoped to. Optional when the branch has exactly one database.

schemas.description: Schemas a read_only or read_write role can use. Default ["public"].

name: delete_postgres_role
title: Delete role
description: Deletes a Postgres role from a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: reset_postgres_role_password
title: Reset role password
description: Sets a new random password for a Postgres role and returns it. Drops the compute's connections.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: list_postgres_databases
title: List databases
description: Lists a branch's databases and their owners.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_postgres_database
title: Retrieve database details
description: Gets a database on a branch and its owner.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: The database name

name: create_postgres_database
title: Create database
description: Creates a database on a branch, owned by owner_name.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name.description: Name of the database to create.

owner_name.description: The name of the role that owns the database

name: update_postgres_database
title: Update database
description: Renames a database or changes its owner.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: The database name

owner_name.description: The name of the role that owns the database

name: delete_postgres_database
title: Delete database
description: Deletes a database and its data from a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: The database name

name: list_postgres_endpoints
title: List compute endpoints
description: Lists the compute endpoints of every branch in a project. For one branch, use list_branch_computes.

name: list_branch_computes
title: List branch endpoints
description: Lists a branch's compute endpoints. For every branch in the project, use list_postgres_endpoints.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_postgres_endpoint
title: Retrieve compute endpoint details
description: Gets a compute endpoint (ep-...), including its host and state.

name: create_postgres_endpoint
title: Create compute endpoint
description: Creates a compute endpoint on a branch; a branch takes one read-write endpoint and any number of read-only. Returns no connection string; use get_connection_string.

branch_id.description: The ID of the branch the compute endpoint will be associated with

region_id.description: The region where the compute endpoint will be created.

pg_settings.description: A raw representation of Postgres settings

pgbouncer_settings.description: Deprecated. PgBouncer settings for the compute endpoint.

enabled_libraries.description: Names of shared preload libraries to enable for the project.

preload_libraries.description: The shared libraries to preload into the project's compute instances.

settings.description: A collection of settings for a compute endpoint

autoscaling_limit_max_cu.description: The maximum number of Compute Units.

pooler_enabled.description: Deprecated. To enable connection pooling, append `-pooler` to the endpoint ID in the connection string.

disabled.description: Whether to restrict connections to the compute endpoint.

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Scale-to-zero idle timeout, in seconds, before the compute suspends.

autoscaling_limit_min_cu.description: The minimum number of Compute Units.

pooler_enabled.description: Deprecated. To enable connection pooling, append `-pooler` to the endpoint ID in the connection string.

disabled.description: Whether to restrict connections to the compute endpoint.

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Scale-to-zero idle timeout, in seconds, before the compute suspends.

name.description: Optional name of the compute endpoint

name: delete_postgres_endpoint
title: Delete compute endpoint
description: Deletes a compute endpoint and drops its connections.

name: start_postgres_endpoint
title: Start compute endpoint
description: Starts a suspended compute endpoint.

name: suspend_postgres_endpoint
title: Suspend compute endpoint
description: Suspends a compute endpoint, dropping its connections.

name: restart_postgres_endpoint
title: Restart compute endpoint
description: Restarts a compute endpoint by suspending and starting it, dropping its connections.

name: list_snapshots
title: List project snapshots
description: Lists a project's snapshots.

name: get_snapshot_schedule
title: Retrieve backup schedule
description: Gets a branch's automatic snapshot schedule.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: set_snapshot_schedule
title: Set snapshot schedule
description: Replaces a branch's automatic snapshot schedule.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

hour.description: The hour of the day to take the snapshot (if applicable).

day.description: The day of the week or month to take the snapshot (if applicable).

month.description: The month of the year to take the snapshot (if applicable).

retention_seconds.description: How long to keep a scheduled snapshot (in seconds) before it's automatically deleted.

schedule.description: Schedule entries defining the backup frequency.

name: create_snapshot
title: Create snapshot
description: Creates a snapshot of a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

lsn.description: The target Log Sequence Number (LSN) to take the snapshot from.

timestamp.description: The target timestamp for the snapshot.

expires_at.description: The time at which the snapshot will be automatically deleted.

name: update_snapshot
title: Update snapshot
description: Renames a snapshot or changes when it expires.

expires_at.description: The date and time when the snapshot will expire.

name: delete_snapshot
title: Delete snapshot
description: Deletes a snapshot.

name: restore_snapshot
title: Restore snapshot
description: Restores a snapshot onto a new branch or onto target_branch_id and waits until it is ready. With finalize false, swap it in later with finalize_branch_restore.

name.description: A name for the newly restored branch.

target_branch_id.description: ID of the branch to restore the snapshot into.

finalize.description: Move computes onto the restored branch now. Default true for a new branch, false onto an existing one.

name: get_auth
title: Retrieve Neon Auth details for the branch
description: Gets a branch's Neon Auth integration record: provider, base URL, JWKS URL, and database. Prefer get_neon_auth_config, which adds the auth settings, unless you only need the record.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

annotations.title: Retrieve Neon Auth details for the branch

name: provision_neon_auth
title: Enable Neon Auth for the branch
description: Enables Neon Auth on a branch and creates the neon_auth schema in its database.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

auth_provider.description: Authentication provider integrated with this Neon Auth configuration.

database_name.description: Name of the database to enable Neon Auth on.

annotations.title: Enable Neon Auth for the branch

name: disable_auth
title: Disable Neon Auth for the branch
description: Disables Neon Auth on a branch. delete_data also drops the neon_auth schema and its tables.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

delete_data.description: If true, deletes the `neon_auth` schema from the database

annotations.title: Disable Neon Auth for the branch

name: update_auth_config
title: Update auth configuration
description: Sets the application name Neon Auth uses in its emails.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name.description: The application name used in auth emails and communications.

name: list_auth_oauth_providers
title: List OAuth providers for the branch
description: Lists the social login providers (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, Vercel, Apple) of a branch's Neon Auth. For Neon Auth as an OAuth server, use get_auth_oauth_server.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

annotations.title: List OAuth providers for the branch

name: add_auth_oauth_provider
title: Add an OAuth provider
description: Adds a social login provider to a branch's Neon Auth. Microsoft and Apple need your own client_id and client_secret; for Apple these are the Services ID and .p8 key, plus apple_team_id and apple_key_id.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

id.description: OAuth provider to configure for Neon Auth.

client_id.description: The client ID issued by the OAuth provider for your application.

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret for the provider.

microsoft_tenant_id.description: Tenant ID for the Microsoft OAuth provider.

apple_key_id.description: Key ID of the Sign in with Apple private key supplied in `client_secret`.

name: update_auth_oauth_provider
title: Update OAuth provider
description: Updates a social login provider on a branch's Neon Auth. For Apple, send a new client_secret (.p8 key) together with its apple_key_id.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

client_id.description: The OAuth client ID registered with the provider.

client_secret.description: OAuth client secret for the provider.

microsoft_tenant_id.description: The tenant ID scoping the Microsoft OAuth provider.

apple_key_id.description: Key ID of the Sign in with Apple private key supplied in `client_secret`.

name: delete_auth_oauth_provider
title: Delete OAuth provider
description: Removes a social login provider from a branch's Neon Auth.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: list_auth_trusted_domains
title: List domains in redirect_uri whitelist
description: Lists the domains a branch's Neon Auth may redirect to after sign-in.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: add_auth_trusted_domain
title: Add domain to redirect_uri whitelist
description: Adds a domain a branch's Neon Auth may redirect to after sign-in.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

domain.description: URI to add to the redirect URI allowlist for the auth provider.

auth_provider.description: Authentication provider integrated with this Neon Auth configuration.

name: delete_auth_trusted_domain
title: Delete domain from redirect_uri whitelist
description: Removes a domain from the ones a branch's Neon Auth may redirect to.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

auth_provider.description: Authentication provider integrated with this Neon Auth configuration.

domain.description: URI to remove from the redirect URI whitelist.

domains.description: Domain names to remove from the redirect URI whitelist for the specified auth provider.

name: create_auth_user
title: Create new auth user
description: Creates a Neon Auth user on a branch who can sign in right away.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

email.description: Email address of the new Neon Auth user to create.

name.description: Display name for the new user.

name: delete_auth_user
title: Delete auth user
description: Deletes a Neon Auth user from a branch. Irreversible.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: update_auth_user_role
title: Update auth user role
description: Sets the roles of a Neon Auth user on a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

roles.description: Roles to assign to the user in the Neon Auth (Better Auth) directory.

name: get_auth_oauth_server
title: Retrieve OAuth provider plugin configuration
description: Gets a branch's Neon Auth OAuth 2.1 server settings (oauth_provider plugin), for example for MCP clients. For social login, use list_auth_oauth_providers.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: update_auth_oauth_server
title: Update OAuth provider plugin configuration
description: Configures a branch's Neon Auth as an OAuth 2.1 server (oauth_provider plugin); root branch only. Enabling needs login_page, consent_page, and a resource or MCP resource. resources replaces the stored list, so send the full list from get_auth_oauth_server.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

enabled.description: Whether the OAuth provider plugin is enabled.

login_page.description: URL of the page that authorization requests redirect to for sign-in.

consent_page.description: URL of the page that authorization requests redirect to for consent.

mcp.description: Needs resource; resource "" removes the MCP configuration. Omitted booleans keep their value. Prefer client_id_metadata_documents over the deprecated dynamic_registration.

resource.description: The MCP server URL that MCP clients (Client ID Metadata Document and dynamically registered) are linked to.

dynamic_registration.description: Whether MCP clients may register themselves via dynamic client registration (RFC 7591).

client_id_metadata_documents.description: Whether MCP clients may identify themselves with an https Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD) URL.

identifier.description: Absolute URL identifying a protected resource.

resources.description: Protected resources that clients can be linked to.

name: list_auth_oauth_clients
title: List OAuth clients
description: Lists the OAuth clients (apps, MCP clients) of a branch's Neon Auth OAuth server, without secrets; not social login providers.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_auth_oauth_client
title: Retrieve an OAuth client
description: Gets an OAuth client of a branch's Neon Auth OAuth server, without its secret.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: create_auth_oauth_client
title: Create an OAuth client
description: Registers an OAuth client with a branch's Neon Auth OAuth server. A confidential client's client_secret is returned once: show it to the user and tell them to store it. resources must already be on the server, or be its MCP resource (get_auth_oauth_server). type is permanent.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

redirect_uris.description: Redirect URIs the client may use.

type.description: Confidential clients authenticate with a client secret.

resources.description: Identifiers of the protected resources to link the client to.

skip_consent.description: Whether to skip the consent prompt for this client.

name: update_auth_oauth_client
title: Update an OAuth client
description: Updates an OAuth client of Neon Auth's OAuth server; redirect_uris and resources replace the stored lists, and type cannot change.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

redirect_uris.description: Redirect URIs the client may use.

skip_consent.description: Whether to skip the consent prompt for this client.

resources.description: Identifiers of the protected resources to link the client to.

name: delete_auth_oauth_client
title: Delete an OAuth client
description: Deletes an OAuth client from Neon Auth's OAuth server, irreversibly; tokens already issued stay valid.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: rotate_auth_oauth_client_secret
title: Rotate an OAuth client secret
description: Issues a new secret for a confidential OAuth client; the old one stops working at once. The new client_secret is returned once: show it to the user and tell them to store it.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: update_auth_allow_localhost
title: Update localhost allow setting
description: Sets whether a branch's Neon Auth accepts localhost origins; turn it off for production. Current value: get_neon_auth_config.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: update_auth_email_and_password
title: Update email and password configuration
description: Updates a branch's Neon Auth email and password sign-in; omitted fields keep their value. Current values: get_neon_auth_config.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

enabled.description: Controls whether email and password authentication is enabled for this project.

require_email_verification.description: When true, users must verify their email address before they can sign in.

auto_sign_in_after_verification.description: Whether users are automatically signed in after verifying their email

send_verification_email_on_sign_up.description: Whether to send a verification email when users sign up.

send_verification_email_on_sign_in.description: Whether to send a verification email when a user with an unverified email signs in.

disable_sign_up.description: Whether to disable new user sign ups.

revoke_sessions_on_password_reset.description: Whether all of a user's sessions are revoked when their password is reset.

name: update_auth_email_provider
title: Update email provider configuration
description: Sets the email provider for Neon Auth's emails: body.type "shared" for Neon's sender, or "standard" with your SMTP details. Test it with send_auth_test_email.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

port.description: TCP port of the SMTP server.

username.description: Username for authenticating with the SMTP server.

password.description: Password for authenticating with the SMTP server.

sender_email.description: Email address used as the From address on outgoing auth emails.

sender_name.description: Display name shown as the sender in outgoing emails.

sender_email.description: Email address used as the sender for outgoing messages from this shared email server.

sender_name.description: Display name shown as the sender in outgoing emails.

body.description: Email provider configuration for the branch's Neon Auth integration.

name: send_auth_test_email
title: Send test email using the saved email provider
description: Sends a test email through the branch's saved standard SMTP provider to recipient_email. Only send to an address the user gave you. A failed send returns success false with error_message, not an error.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

recipient_email.description: The email address to send the test email to.

annotations.title: Send test email using the saved email provider

name: update_auth_plugins_magic_link
title: Update magic link plugin configuration
description: Updates the Neon Auth magic link plugin; omitted fields keep their value. Current values: get_neon_auth_config.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

enabled.description: Whether to enable the magic link plugin.

expires_in.description: Minutes until the magic link expires.

disable_sign_up.description: When true, sign-up via magic link is disabled.

name: update_auth_plugins_organization
title: Update organization plugin configuration
description: Updates the Neon Auth organization plugin, which lets your app's users form organizations (not Neon organizations). Omitted fields keep their value. Current values: get_neon_auth_config.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

enabled.description: Controls whether the organization plugin is active for the organization.

organization_limit.description: Maximum organizations a user can belong to (created or joined).

send_invitation_email.description: When true, invited users receive an email containing an accept link.

name: update_auth_plugins_phone_number
title: Update phone number plugin configuration
description: Updates the Neon Auth SMS OTP plugin; omitted fields keep their value. SMS needs a webhook with the send.otp event (update_auth_webhooks). Current values: get_neon_auth_config.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

enabled.description: Whether the phone number plugin is enabled.

otp_expires_in.description: Time in seconds before the OTP expires

name: update_auth_webhooks
title: Update Neon Auth webhook configuration
description: Replaces a branch's Neon Auth webhook configuration; omitted fields reset, so { enabled: false } alone clears webhook_url and enabled_events. Send every field to keep, read from get_neon_auth_config.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

webhook_url.description: Destination URL that receives webhook event payloads.

enabled_events.description: Event types that trigger this webhook.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time, in seconds, to wait for a response from the webhook endpoint.

name: update_auth_logs_export
title: Update Neon Auth logs export setting
description: Turns the export of a branch's Neon Auth events to Neon Platform logs on or off. A project without logs export accepts only enabled: false; enabling there returns 404 feature not available. get_neon_auth_config reports the current value as logs_export, or null where logs export is not available.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

enabled.description: Whether Neon Auth events are exported to Neon Platform logs.

annotations.title: Update Neon Auth logs export setting

name: get_data_api
title: Retrieve Neon Data API configuration
description: Gets the Neon Data API configuration for one database on a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: The database name

name: provision_neon_data_api
title: Create Neon Data API
description: Creates the Neon Data API, a REST interface over database_name, on a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: The database name

auth_provider.description: Authentication provider for the Neon Data API.

jwks_url.description: URL of the JWKS endpoint used to verify JWTs for this Data API.

provider_name.description: Display name for the authentication provider.

add_default_grants.description: Grant all permissions to the tables in the public schema to authenticated users

skip_auth_schema.description: Skip creating the auth schema and RLS functions

db_anon_role.description: Database role to use for anonymous requests

db_extra_search_path.description: Extra schemas to add to the search path

db_max_rows.description: Hard limit on the number of rows returned in a single Data API response.

db_schemas.description: List of schemas to expose via the API.

jwt_role_claim_key.description: JWT claim key to use for role extraction

jwt_cache_max_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime of the Data API's JWT cache, in seconds.

server_timing_enabled.description: When enabled, the Data API adds `Server-Timing` headers to each response showing database execution and internal processing time.

settings.description: Auth and schema configuration for the Data API.

name: update_data_api
title: Update Neon Data API
description: Updates the Neon Data API settings for a database and refreshes its schema cache.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: The database name

db_anon_role.description: Database role to use for anonymous requests

db_extra_search_path.description: Extra schemas to add to the search path

db_max_rows.description: Hard limit on the number of rows returned in a single Data API response.

db_schemas.description: List of schemas to expose via the API.

jwt_role_claim_key.description: JWT claim key to use for role extraction

jwt_cache_max_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime of the Data API's JWT cache, in seconds.

server_timing_enabled.description: When enabled, the Data API adds `Server-Timing` headers to each response showing database execution and internal processing time.

name: delete_data_api
title: Delete Neon Data API
description: Deletes the Neon Data API for a database; requests to its endpoint start failing.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

database_name.description: The database name

name: query_logs
title: Query branch logs
description: Returns a branch's log records. Filters combine with AND; pass logql or structured filters, not both. Pass since or start_time, not both; default last hour, max seven days. Private beta: a branch without logs returns 404 telemetry_not_enabled. Stream labels: query_loki_logs. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

since.description: A length of time as a count and a unit, for example `30m`, `6h`, or `7d`.

start_time.description: Inclusive beginning of the query window.

end_time.description: Exclusive end of the query window.

limit.description: Maximum number of log records to return per page.

source.description: The Neon service that emitted the log record.

service_name.description: Match the OpenTelemetry `service.name` resource attribute exactly.

scope_name.description: Match the OpenTelemetry instrumentation scope name exactly.

severity_text.description: Match the OpenTelemetry severity text exactly.

body_contains.description: Match records whose rendered `message` contains this case-sensitive substring.

trace_id.description: Match records associated with this OpenTelemetry trace ID.

logql.description: Escape hatch for selections the structured filters cannot express: a raw LogQL expression, evaluated against this branch's log stream.

name: list_log_fields
title: List branch log fields
description: Lists the low-cardinality log fields seen on a branch, for list_log_field_values.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: list_log_field_values
title: List branch log field values
description: Lists the distinct values of one log field; a field the branch never emitted returns unknown_field. Pass since or start_time, not both; default last six hours, max seven days.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

since.description: Length of the lookup window, ending at `end_time` or at the current time when `end_time` is omitted.

start_time.description: Inclusive beginning of the lookup window.

end_time.description: Exclusive end of the lookup window.

source.description: Only consider records emitted by this Neon service.

limit.description: Maximum number of distinct values to return.

name: query_loki_logs
title: Query branch logs (Loki)
description: Runs a LogQL range query on a branch's logs and returns Loki's response: data.result groups lines by stream label as [nanosecond timestamp, line]. query_logs has structured filters; list_log_fields and list_log_field_values list labels. No cursor: limit lines, or the silent 10,000 cap, may mean more exist; narrow the window.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

query.description: LogQL stream selector with optional line filters, e.g. {entity_type="function"} |= "error". The source label is entity_type. No parsers, formatting stages, or metric queries.

since.description: Lookback as a Go duration such as 30m or 24h, ending at end or now. Defaults to 1h. start takes precedence.

start.description: Window start as RFC 3339 or Unix nanoseconds.

end.description: Window end as RFC 3339 or Unix nanoseconds. Defaults to now.

limit.description: Maximum log lines. The server enforces its own cap.

name: get_ai_gateway
title: Get branch AI Gateway endpoint
description: Gets a branch's AI Gateway host; a 404 says why it is unavailable.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: list_functions
title: List functions on the branch
description: Lists the functions on a branch. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

limit.description: Specify a value from 1 to 1000 to limit number of functions in the response

name: get_function
title: Get function details
description: Gets a function on a branch by slug.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: update_function
title: Update a function
description: Sets a function's display name; null resets it to the slug. Only the branch that owns the function can rename it.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name.description: New display name for the function.

name: delete_function
title: Delete a function on the branch
description: Deletes a function from a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

annotations.title: Delete a function on the branch

name: deploy_function

description: Deploys a function version from any of zip, environment, and runtime; omitted ones keep the latest value, and the first deployment needs zip. It can return while still pending.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

zip.description: Base64-encoded ZIP of the function source. Omit to reuse the latest bundle; required for the first deployment.

runtime.description: The Node.js runtime for the deployment.

environment.description: Optional JSON object (a string-to-string map) of environment variables for the deployment, e.g. {"KEY":"VALUE"}.

name: list_functions_custom_domains
title: List the custom domains on a branch
description: Lists a branch's custom domains and their targets. Returns every page. Pass limit to cap how many.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

limit.description: Specify a value from 1 to 1000 to limit number of domains in the response

annotations.title: List the custom domains on a branch

name: register_functions_custom_domain
title: Register a custom domain on a branch
description: Routes a domain you own to a function: entity_type function, entity_id the slug from list_functions. It goes live once a CNAME to the returned cname_target resolves.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

domain.description: The custom domain to register (for example `dashboard.acme.com`).

entity_type.description: The kind of branch entity to point the domain at.

annotations.title: Register a custom domain on a branch

name: delete_functions_custom_domain
title: Delete a custom domain from a branch
description: Removes a custom domain from a branch and stops routing it.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

annotations.title: Delete a custom domain from a branch

name: list_triggers
title: List triggers on the branch
description: Lists a branch's function triggers, including inherited ones, which stay disabled on this branch until enabled.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_trigger
title: Get a trigger
description: Gets a function trigger on a branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: create_trigger
title: Create a trigger
description: Creates a trigger that calls a function on a five-field UTC cron schedule, or after an upload to one bucket, optionally under a key prefix. Names are unique on the branch.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

function_slug.description: The branch-local Function slug to invoke.

name.description: Human-readable name, unique among triggers visible on the branch.

function_path.description: Path passed to the target Function.

cron.description: Numeric five-field cron expression (minute through day-of-week), interpreted in UTC.

schedule.description: A numeric five-field cron schedule interpreted in UTC.

enabled.description: Whether future occurrences should be scheduled.

function_slug.description: The branch-local Function slug to invoke.

name.description: Human-readable name, unique among triggers visible on the branch.

function_path.description: Path passed to the target Function.

bucket_name.description: The exact object-storage bucket name to watch.

prefix.description: Optional object-key prefix of at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

storage_object_created.description: Matches successful uploads to one exact bucket and, when configured, an object-key prefix.

enabled.description: Whether successful matching uploads should invoke the Function.

name: update_trigger
title: Update a trigger
description: Updates a function trigger; body.type must match its kind. Editing an inherited trigger makes a local copy, disabled unless this request enables it.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

cron.description: Numeric five-field cron expression (minute through day-of-week), interpreted in UTC.

schedule.description: A numeric five-field cron schedule interpreted in UTC.

enabled.description: True enables and false disables future scheduling.

bucket_name.description: The exact object-storage bucket name to watch.

prefix.description: Optional object-key prefix of at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

storage_object_created.description: Matches successful uploads to one exact bucket and, when configured, an object-key prefix.

enabled.description: True enables and false disables future matching uploads.

name: delete_trigger
title: Delete a trigger
description: Deletes a function trigger, or hides an inherited one on this branch. Invocations already queued still run.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: list_credentials

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_storage

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: list_storage_buckets

name: delete_storage_bucket

description: Soft-deletes every object on this branch whose key starts with prefix and returns the count; inherited objects stay.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

prefix.description: Key prefix to delete, ending in / (for example app/avatars/).

annotations.title: Delete every object under a key prefix (folder) in a bucket

name: presign_storage_object
title: Presign an upload or download for an object in a bucket
description: Returns a short-lived presigned PUT or GET URL for one object, with the headers to send; no S3 credentials needed.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

content_type.description: The `Content-Type` to bind into the signed request.

expires_in_seconds.description: How long the presigned URL stays valid, in seconds.

annotations.title: Presign an upload or download for an object in a bucket

name: get_realtime
title: Retrieve Realtime state
description: Gets a branch's Realtime state, URL, and allowed origins; the secret comes from get_realtime_secret.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: enable_realtime
title: Enable Realtime
description: Enables Realtime on a branch, or changes its allowed origins, and waits until it is applied.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

allowed_origins.description: The browser origins allowed to connect, each `http` or `https` with a host and optional port and no path.

name: disable_realtime
title: Disable Realtime
description: Disables Realtime on a branch, discarding its secret, and waits until it is applied.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: get_realtime_secret
title: Retrieve the Realtime shared secret
description: Gets the secret the application backend issues Realtime tokens with; 404 until enable_realtime has run. Requires write access: the secret lets its holder issue Realtime tokens for the branch, so it is unavailable in read-only mode.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.

name: rotate_realtime_secret
title: Rotate the Realtime shared secret
description: Replaces a branch's Realtime secret and waits until the old one stops working. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. Then update the application backend from get_realtime_secret.

branch_id.description: A br-... id, not a name.
